approved_command_preview: Retry issue #426 in an isolated worktree after correcting the combined-release synthetic fixture to carry four valid conversation starters; apply the hash-pinned helper, materialize, run focused plus full governed agent-runtime validation, commit/push only the guarded issue branch, and leave main clean.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$branch = 'issue-426-human-first-openai-gpt-packages'
$expectedHead = '3d683048b4571ce60f9fafe1e89ef517b9f284fc'
$helperRootRel = '.github/chatgpt_staging/in/exec-20260828-issue426-human-first-openai-packages-001'
$helperRel = "$helperRootRel/edit426.zb64"
$worktree = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'issue426-human-first-worktree'
$compressed = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'edit426.zlib'
$script = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'edit426.py'
function Invoke-Logged([string[]]$GitArgs) { Write-Host "git $($GitArgs -join ' ')"; $output = & git @GitArgs; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($output) { $output | Out-Host }; if ($code -ne 0) { throw "git failed with exit $code`: git $($GitArgs -join ' ')" } }
Invoke-Logged @('fetch','--no-tags','origin',"refs/heads/$branch`:refs/remotes/origin/$branch")
$remoteHead = (& git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$branch").Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $remoteHead -ne $expectedHead) { throw "Branch head guard failed: expected $expectedHead got $remoteHead" }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $worktree) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $worktree -Recurse -Force }
Invoke-Logged @('worktree','add','--detach',$worktree,"refs/remotes/origin/$branch")
$entered = $false
try {
  Push-Location $worktree; $entered = $true
  $head = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $head -ne $expectedHead) { throw "Worktree head guard failed: expected $expectedHead got $head" }
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $helperRel -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Missing staged helper: $helperRel" }
  [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($compressed, [Convert]::FromBase64String((Get-Content -LiteralPath $helperRel -Raw)))
  python -c "import pathlib,zlib,sys; pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_bytes(zlib.decompress(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()))" $compressed $script
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'helper decompression failed' }
  $scriptSha = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $script).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($scriptSha -ne '6c4e84a6a14e2fb074474049f6546b8e9ab3bb99964ec5424e49453a9eccfdd4') { throw "Helper SHA-256 mismatch: $scriptSha" }
  python $script
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'bounded edit helper failed' }
  $fixturePath = 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release_selftest.py'
  $fixtureText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fixturePath -Raw
  $oldFixture = '        "conversation_starters": [],'
  $newFixture = '        "conversation_starters": ["Starter one", "Starter two", "Starter three", "Starter four"],'
  $fixtureCount = ([regex]::Matches($fixtureText, [regex]::Escape($oldFixture))).Count
  if ($fixtureCount -ne 1) { throw "Expected exactly one stale conversation-starter fixture, found $fixtureCount" }
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $fixturePath -Value ($fixtureText.Replace($oldFixture, $newFixture)) -NoNewline -Encoding utf8
  Invoke-Logged @('rm','-r','--',$helperRootRel)
  python project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_dcoir_analyst.py --materialize
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'DCOIR package materialization failed' }
  python project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_usb_reporting.py --materialize
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'USB package materialization failed' }
  $py = @(
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_dcoir_analyst.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_usb_reporting.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release_selftest.py'
  )
  python -m py_compile @py
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'py_compile failed' }
  python project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'DCOIR builder selftest failed' }
  python project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'USB builder selftest failed' }
  python project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release_selftest.py
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'combined deployment release selftest failed' }
  $commands = @(
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/validate_shared_agent_source_contract.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/validate_shared_agent_source_contract_selftest.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/materialize_agent_behavior_adapters.py','--check'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/materialize_agent_behavior_adapters_selftest.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/project_agent_knowledge.py','--check'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/project_agent_knowledge_selftest.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_dcoir_analyst.py','--check'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_usb_reporting.py','--check'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py')
  )
  foreach ($cmd in $commands) { python @cmd; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Governed agent-runtime command failed: python $($cmd -join ' ')" } }
  Invoke-Logged @('diff','--check')
  $allowed = @(
    '.github/chatgpt_staging/in/exec-20260828-issue426-human-first-openai-packages-001/edit426.b64.part00',
    '.github/chatgpt_staging/in/exec-20260828-issue426-human-first-openai-packages-001/edit426.b64.part01',
    '.github/chatgpt_staging/in/exec-20260828-issue426-human-first-openai-packages-001/edit426.zb64',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/provider_adapters/openai_dcoir_analyst/Adapter_Manifest.json',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/provider_adapters/openai_usb_reporting/Adapter_Manifest.json',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_dcoir_analyst.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_usb_reporting.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release_selftest.py',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/docs/Release_Parity_Deployment_Readback.md',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/README.md',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/generated/packages/openai_dcoir_analyst/manifest.json',
    'project_sources/agent_runtime/generated/packages/openai_usb_reporting/manifest.json'
  )
  Write-Host 'Changed files before commit:'
  Invoke-Logged @('status','--short')
  $changed = @(& git status --porcelain | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(3) }); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git status failed' }
  $unexpected = @($changed | Where-Object { $_ -notin $allowed }); if ($unexpected.Count -gt 0) { throw "Unexpected changed paths: $($unexpected -join ', ')" }
  if ($changed.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No implementation changes were produced' }
  Invoke-Logged @('config','user.name','github-actions[bot]')
  Invoke-Logged @('config','user.email','41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com')
  $gitAdd = @('add','-A','--') + $allowed
  Invoke-Logged $gitAdd
  Invoke-Logged @('commit','-m','Make OpenAI GPT deployment packages human-first')
  $newHead = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to read implementation commit' }
  Invoke-Logged @('push','origin',"HEAD:refs/heads/$branch")
  Write-Host "Implementation branch head: $newHead"
  $dirty = @(& git status --porcelain); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'final git status failed' }; if ($dirty.Count -ne 0) { throw "Implementation worktree is not clean after push: $($dirty -join '; ')" }
}
finally {
  if ($entered) { Pop-Location }
  & git worktree remove --force $worktree 2>$null
  & git worktree prune
}
